title: Anchored
subtitle: 21 Days from Anxious to At Peace
tagline: A 21-Day Devotional & Prayer Journal for Women
coverVerse: “An anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast”
short: For the woman who can’t turn her mind off. Twenty-one days with the God who calms storms.
description: Anxiety tells you that you’re on your own, that if you don’t hold everything together, it will all fall apart. Anchored answers that lie, one day at a time.

Over 21 days you’ll walk with real people in the Bible who were overwhelmed: a runaway servant in the desert, an exhausted prophet under a tree, a busy woman in her kitchen, a fisherman sinking in the waves, and Jesus Himself praying in a garden at night. In every story, God comes close.

weeks.name: God Sees You
weeks.desc: Naming what you carry, and meeting the God who comes close.

weeks.name: Hand It Over
weeks.desc: Practical, daily ways to put your worries in His hands.

weeks.name: Stand Anchored
weeks.desc: Who you are in Christ when the next storm comes.

inside: 21 two-page days: a reading, one truth, a practice, a prayer and journal space
A “Tomorrow” glimpse at the end of every day to keep you coming back
Habit tracker, weekly reflections, prayer list and answered-prayer log
8 cut-out Scripture cards for your mirror, car or desk

title: Breathe
subtitle: 21 Days to Know the Holy Spirit
coverVerse: “He breathed on them, and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Ghost”
short: Not a force or a feeling, but a Person who loves you. Meet the Holy Spirit in Scripture.
description: Maybe you’ve loved Jesus for years, but when someone mentions the Holy Spirit, things get a little blurry. Is He a feeling? A force? Something only certain churches talk about?

Jesus called Him a Comforter, a Helper, a Teacher and a Guide, and said it was better for us that He would come. Breathe spends 21 days in Scripture getting to know the Holy Spirit as a Person: the One who lives in you, prays for you, reminds you of Jesus’ words and walks with you through ordinary days.

weeks.name: Who He Is
weeks.desc: Meeting the Holy Spirit in Scripture as a Person who loves you.

weeks.name: How He Speaks
weeks.desc: The ways the Spirit guides, reminds, comforts and leads.

weeks.name: Walk With Him
weeks.desc: A daily life in step with the Spirit, from prayer to purpose.

inside: 21 two-page days built around one passage of Scripture each
Breath prayers, listening exercises and simple daily practices
Habit tracker, weekly reflections, prayer list and answered-prayer log
8 cut-out Scripture cards to keep His Word close

title: Kept
subtitle: 21 Days on Love, Waiting & God’s Design
coverVerse: “Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life”
short: Biblical wisdom for the heart: waiting well, choosing wisely and building a love that lasts.
description: Our culture says love is a feeling to follow. Scripture says love is a gift from God, a covenant to keep, and that the heart is a garden worth guarding.

Kept is a 21-day devotional for singles, dating couples and married couples: what the Bible says about your worth before any relationship, waiting on God’s timing, purity as freedom, choosing a partner with wisdom, and building a home on the Rock.

weeks.name: Guard Your Heart
weeks.desc: Your worth, your longings and your waiting, held in God’s hands.

weeks.name: Choose With Wisdom
weeks.desc: What Scripture says to look for, and what to walk away from.

weeks.name: Build to Last
weeks.desc: The everyday habits of a love that keeps its promises.

inside: 21 two-page days, from Proverbs and Ruth to the Song of Solomon and 1 Corinthians 13
Practical steps for singles, dating couples and married couples
Habit tracker, weekly reflections, prayer list and answered-prayer log
8 cut-out Scripture cards to keep your heart anchored

title: Named
subtitle: 21 Days to Know Who God Says You Are
tagline: A 21-Day Devotional & Prayer Journal for Women
coverVerse: “I will give him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written”
short: For every woman tired of comparison, rejection and the names other people gave her.
description: Comparison, rejection and old labels can shout louder than the truth. Named is a 21-day journey through the names God gives His daughters: seen, remembered, forgiven, chosen, His.

Each day walks alongside a woman of the Bible, like Leah, Rahab, Ruth, Hannah, Esther and Mary Magdalene, and the moment God met her by name, so you can stop striving for worth and start living from it.

weeks.name: Seen
weeks.desc: The God who made you, knows you and has never once overlooked you.

weeks.name: Forgiven & Free
weeks.desc: Jesus meets women with shame and sends them away whole.

weeks.name: Chosen & Sent
weeks.desc: A new name, a new purpose and a place in His story.

inside: 21 two-page days, each built around a woman of the Bible or a promise about your identity
Mirror truths, honest journal prompts and written prayers
Habit tracker, weekly reflections, prayer list and answered-prayer log
8 cut-out Scripture cards with the names God calls you

title: Ask
subtitle: 21 Days to a Prayer Life That Lasts
coverVerse: “Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you”
short: Twenty-one guided days to build a prayer life that lasts, and to remember how He answered.
description: Most of us want to pray more. Few of us were ever shown how. Ask is a guided prayer journal that walks you through the prayer Jesus taught, the honest prayers of people in Scripture, and the habits that keep prayer going.
Every day gives you a passage, a simple practice, a prayer to start with and space for your own words, plus a log to record how God answered, so you can look back for years.

weeks.name: Teach Us to Pray
weeks.desc: Walking line by line through the prayer Jesus gave His friends.

weeks.name: Prayers That Moved Heaven
weeks.desc: Learning from Abraham, Moses, David, Solomon, Elijah, Daniel and Jesus.

weeks.name: Keep Asking
weeks.desc: Persistence, listening, waiting and remembering how He answered.

inside: 21 two-page guided prayer days with space to write your own prayers
The Lord’s Prayer, line by line, as a pattern you can use every day
Prayer list and answered-prayer log to record God’s faithfulness
8 cut-out Scripture cards about prayer
